<!doctype html>

<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head><base target="_top">

  <meta charset="utf-8">

  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">

  <title>مدخل البيانات</title>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Noto+Kufi+Arabic:wght@500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">



  <style>

    :root{

      --navy:#0d2740;

      --teal:#2d8197;

      --teal-dark:#18566a;

      --gold:#c7a35b;

      --paper:#fbfaf7;

      --white:#fff;

      --ink:#173044;

      --muted:#667987;

      --line:#e8dfcf;

      --ok:#157347;

      --danger:#b33b32;

      --shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(18,55,72,.10);

      --radius:18px;

    }



    *{box-sizing:border-box}



    body{

      margin:0;

      color:var(--ink);

      background:

        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%,rgba(199,163,91,.08),transparent 34%),

        linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,var(--paper) 100%);

      font-family:Arial,sans-serif;

      min-height:100vh;

    }



    button,input{font:inherit}

    button{cursor:pointer}



    .shell{

      min-height:100vh;

      display:grid;

      grid-template-columns:260px minmax(0,1fr);

    }



    .side{

      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#174e5d 0%,#0e3e50 100%);

      color:#fff;

      padding:26px 20px;

      display:flex;

      flex-direction:column;

      gap:22px;

      position:sticky;

      top:0;

      height:100vh;

    }



    .brand{

      background:#fff;

      color:var(--teal-dark);

      border-radius:18px;

      padding:20px 16px;

      text-align:center;

      box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.12);

    }



    .brand-mark{

      width:62px;

      height:62px;

      border:2px solid var(--gold);

      border-radius:50%;

      margin:0 auto 10px;

      display:grid;

      place-items:center;

      font-size:26px;

      font-weight:900;

    }



    .brand strong{

      display:block;

      font-size:17px;

      line-height:1.6;

    }



    .nav-title{

      color:#e5c883;

      font-size:13px;

      font-weight:800;

      margin:8px 8px 0;

    }



    .nav a,.logout{

      width:100%;

      display:flex;

      align-items:center;

      gap:10px;

      padding:13px 14px;

      border-radius:12px;

      text-decoration:none;

      color:#eaf4f5;

      border:1px solid transparent;

      background:transparent;

    }



    .nav a:hover,.nav a.active{

      background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);

      border-color:rgba(229,200,131,.55);

    }



    .logout{

      margin-top:auto;

      border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);

    }



    .logout[hidden]{display:none}



    .main{

      padding:34px clamp(22px,4vw,64px) 48px;

      min-width:0;

    }



    .hero{

      display:flex;

      justify-content:space-between;

      gap:20px;

      align-items:flex-end;

      border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);

      padding-bottom:18px;

    }



    .hero small{

      color:#8a672d;

      font-weight:700;

    }



    h1{

      margin:6px 0 4px;

      font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,48px);

      color:#102c44;

    }



    .hero p{

      margin:0;

      color:var(--muted);

    }



    .home-link{

      flex:0 0 auto;

      color:var(--teal-dark);

      text-decoration:none;

      border:1px solid var(--line);

      background:#fff;

      border-radius:12px;

      padding:11px 16px;

      font-weight:700;

    }



    .panel{

      background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);

      border:1px solid var(--line);

      border-radius:var(--radius);

      box-shadow:var(--shadow);

    }



    .login-card{

      max-width:520px;

      margin:56px auto;

      padding:30px;

    }



    .login-card h2{

      margin:0 0 8px;

      font-size:25px;

    }



    .login-card p{

      color:var(--muted);

      line-height:1.8;

    }



    label{

      display:block;

      font-weight:800;

      margin:22px 0 8px;

    }



    input{

      width:100%;

      border:1px solid #d9d1c4;

      border-radius:12px;

      padding:14px 15px;

      color:var(--ink);

      background:#fff;

      outline:none;

    }



    input:focus{

      border-color:var(--teal);

      box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(45,129,151,.12);

    }



    .primary,.secondary,.success,.ghost{

      border:0;

      border-radius:12px;

      padding:13px 18px;

      font-weight:800;

      transition:.18s ease;

    }



    .primary{

      background:var(--teal);

      color:#fff;

      width:100%;

      margin-top:16px;

    }



    .primary:hover,.success:hover{

      transform:translateY(-1px);

      filter:brightness(.96);

    }



    .secondary{

      background:#edf5f6;

      color:var(--teal-dark);

    }



    .success{

      background:var(--ok);

      color:#fff;

    }



    .ghost{

      background:#fff;

      color:var(--ink);

      border:1px solid var(--line);

    }



    button:disabled{

      opacity:.55;

      cursor:not-allowed;

      transform:none!important;

    }



    .message{

      display:none;

      margin-top:14px;

      padding:12px 14px;

      border-radius:11px;

      line-height:1.6;

    }



    .message.error{

      display:block;

      color:var(--danger);

      background:#fff0ee;

      border:1px solid #f0c4bf;

    }



    .message.ok{

      display:block;

      color:var(--ok);

      background:#eef9f2;

      border:1px solid #c5e8d1;

    }



    .dashboard{display:none}



    .stats{

      display:grid;

      grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

      gap:16px;

      margin:26px 0;

    }



    .stat{padding:22px}

    .stat span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}

    .stat strong{display:block;font-size:34px;margin-top:7px}

    .stat.done strong{color:var(--ok)}

    .stat.left strong{color:#a86b18}



    .progress-wrap{

      padding:22px;

      margin-bottom:18px;

    }



    .progress-head{

      display:flex;

      justify-content:space-between;

      gap:16px;

      align-items:center;

      margin-bottom:12px;

    }



    .progress-head strong{font-size:19px}



    .progress-track{

      height:12px;

      background:#edf0ef;

      border-radius:999px;

      overflow:hidden;

    }



    .progress-bar{

      height:100%;

      width:0;

      background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--teal));

      transition:width .35s;

    }



    .toolbar{

      display:flex;

      gap:10px;

      flex-wrap:wrap;

      margin:18px 0;

    }



    .current{overflow:hidden}



    .card-head{

      padding:20px 22px;

      background:linear-gradient(110deg,var(--navy),var(--teal-dark));

      color:#fff;

      display:flex;

      justify-content:space-between;

      gap:15px;

      align-items:center;

    }



    .card-head small{opacity:.8}

    .card-head h2{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:25px}



    .badge{

      background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);

      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);

      padding:8px 12px;

      border-radius:999px;

    }



    .fields{

      display:grid;

      grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

      gap:1px;

      background:var(--line);

    }



    .field{

      background:#fff;

      padding:18px 20px;

      min-height:94px;

    }



    .field span{

      display:block;

      color:var(--muted);

      font-size:13px;

      margin-bottom:8px;

    }



    .field strong{

      display:block;

      word-break:break-word;

      line-height:1.6;

    }



    .card-actions{

      padding:18px 20px;

      display:flex;

      justify-content:space-between;

      gap:12px;

      flex-wrap:wrap;

      background:#fff;

    }



    .action-group{

      display:flex;

      gap:10px;

      flex-wrap:wrap;

    }



    .empty{

      padding:44px;

      text-align:center;

    }



    .empty .icon{font-size:50px}

    .empty h2{margin:12px 0 6px}

    .empty p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}



    .queue{

      margin-top:20px;

      overflow:hidden;

    }



    .queue-title{

      padding:18px 20px;

      border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);

      display:flex;

      justify-content:space-between;

      align-items:center;

    }



    .queue-title h3{margin:0}

    .table-wrap{overflow:auto}



    table{

      width:100%;

      border-collapse:collapse;

      min-width:1200px;

    }



    th,td{

      padding:13px 14px;

      text-align:right;

      border-bottom:1px solid #eee8df;

      white-space:nowrap;

    }



    th{

      background:#f6f2ea;

      color:#6c542d;

      font-size:13px;

    }



    tbody tr:first-child{background:#f2fafb}



    .privacy{

      margin:18px 2px 0;

      color:var(--muted);

      font-size:13px;

      line-height:1.7;

    }



    .attachment-feature-note{

      margin:18px 0 0;

      padding:12px 16px;

      border:1px solid #b9d9e1;

      border-radius:12px;

      background:#eef8fa;

      color:#174e5d;

      font-weight:700;

    }



    .attachment-viewer{

      margin:18px 0;

      padding:20px;

      border-top:4px solid #2f7f96;

    }



    .attachment-viewer[hidden]{display:none}



    .attachment-viewer-head{

      display:flex;

      align-items:center;

      justify-content:space-between;

      gap:14px;

      margin-bottom:15px;

    }



    .attachment-viewer-head strong{

      display:block;

      color:#174e5d;

      font-size:21px;

      margin-bottom:4px;

    }



    .attachment-viewer-head span{color:var(--muted)}



    .attachment-preview{

      min-height:260px;

      display:grid;

      place-items:center;

      overflow:hidden;

      border:1px solid var(--line);

      border-radius:14px;

      background:#f8faf9;

    }



    .attachment-preview img{

      display:block;

      max-width:100%;

      max-height:70vh;

      object-fit:contain;

    }



    .attachment-preview iframe{

      display:block;

      width:100%;

      height:70vh;

      min-height:520px;

      border:0;

      background:#fff;

    }



    .attachment-preview.pdf-pages{

      display:block;

      max-height:72vh;

      overflow:auto;

      padding:16px;

      text-align:center;

    }



    .attachment-preview.pdf-pages canvas{

      display:block;

      max-width:100%;

      height:auto!important;

      margin:0 auto 16px;

      background:#fff;

      box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(23,63,77,.12);

    }



    .attachment-actions{

      display:flex;

      justify-content:flex-end;

      gap:10px;

      margin-top:14px;

    }



    .attachment-download{

      display:inline-flex;

      align-items:center;

      justify-content:center;

      min-height:44px;

      padding:0 18px;

      border-radius:10px;

      background:#2f7f96;

      color:#fff;

      font-weight:700;

      text-decoration:none;

    }



    .attachment-loading{

      min-height:320px;

      display:grid;

      place-items:center;

      text-align:center;

      color:#174e5d;

    }



    .attachment-loading[hidden]{display:none}



    .attachment-loading strong{

      display:block;

      font-size:25px;

      margin-bottom:10px;

    }



    .attachment-loading span{

      display:block;

      color:var(--muted);

      line-height:1.8;

    }



    body.attachment-mode .shell{display:block}

    body.attachment-mode .side,

    body.attachment-mode .hero,

    body.attachment-mode #loginView{display:none!important}

    body.attachment-mode .main{

      min-height:100vh;

      padding:28px;

      display:grid;

      place-items:center;

    }

    body.attachment-mode #dashboard{

      display:block;

      width:min(1180px,100%);

      margin:0;

    }

    body.attachment-mode #dashboard > *{display:none!important}

    body.attachment-mode #dashboard > #attachmentLoading:not([hidden]),

    body.attachment-mode #dashboard > #attachmentViewer:not([hidden]){display:grid!important}

    body.attachment-mode #attachmentViewer{

      margin:0;

      width:100%;

    }

    body.attachment-mode #attachmentViewer .attachment-viewer-head,

    body.attachment-mode #attachmentViewer .attachment-actions{display:flex!important}

    body.attachment-mode #closeAttachmentBtn{display:none!important}



    @media(max-width:650px){

      body.attachment-mode .main{padding:12px}

      body.attachment-mode #attachmentViewer{padding:13px}

      body.attachment-mode .attachment-preview iframe{min-height:72vh}

    }



    .loading::after{

      content:"";

      display:inline-block;

      width:15px;

      height:15px;

      border:2px solid currentColor;

      border-left-color:transparent;

      border-radius:50%;

      animation:spin .7s linear infinite;

      margin-right:8px;

      vertical-align:-2px;

    }



    @keyframes spin{

      to{transform:rotate(360deg)}

    }



    @media(max-width:980px){

      .shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}

      .side{

        height:auto;

        position:static;

        padding:15px;

        display:grid;

        grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;

        align-items:center;

      }

      .brand{

        display:flex;

        align-items:center;

        gap:12px;

        padding:10px 14px;

        text-align:right;

      }

      .brand-mark{

        width:43px;

        height:43px;

        margin:0;

        font-size:18px;

      }

      .nav{

        display:flex;

        justify-content:flex-end;

        gap:7px;

      }

      .nav-title,.logout{display:none!important}

      .nav a{width:auto}

      .main{padding-top:24px}

      .fields{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}

    }



    @media(max-width:650px){

      .hero{

        align-items:flex-start;

        flex-direction:column;

      }

      .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}

      .fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}

      .card-head{

        align-items:flex-start;

        flex-direction:column;

      }

      .card-actions,.progress-head{

        align-items:stretch;

        flex-direction:column;

      }

      .action-group{

        display:grid;

        grid-template-columns:1fr;

      }

      .action-group button{width:100%}

      .side{grid-template-columns:1fr}

      .nav{justify-content:stretch}

      .nav a{

        flex:1;

        justify-content:center;

      }

    }

  

     

    body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;background-color:#f6f3eb}

    .side{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#174e5d 0%,#0e3e50 100%);padding:22px 18px}

    .brand{padding:15px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(199,173,112,.45);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}

    .brand-mark{width:150px;height:112px;border:0;border-radius:0;margin:0 auto 8px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}

    .brand-mark img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}

    .brand strong{color:#174e5d;font-size:18px}

    .main{background:radial-gradient(circle at 14% 8%,rgba(47,127,150,.06),transparent 28%),#f6f3eb}

    .hero{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 28px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:1px solid rgba(199,173,112,.45);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(18,55,72,.08);align-items:center}

    .hero h1{color:#2f7f96;font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,44px)}

    .hero small{color:#7c6a3a}.hero p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8}

    .home-link{border:2px solid #2f7f96;color:#2f7f96;border-radius:12px}.home-link:hover{background:#2f7f96;color:#fff}

    .login-card,.dashboard{max-width:1180px}.login-card{max-width:650px;border-color:rgba(199,173,112,.45)}

    .stats{margin-top:24px}.stat{border-top:4px solid #2f7f96}.stat.done{border-top-color:#2f8f63}.stat.left{border-top-color:#c98a2c}

    .toolbar{padding:14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}

    .student-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin-top:18px}

    .student-item{overflow:hidden;border-top:4px solid #2f7f96}

    .student-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 20px;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#174e5d,#2f7f96);color:#fff}

    .student-head h3{margin:0;font-size:20px}.student-number{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);font-weight:800}.student-status{padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:999px;font-size:13px}

    .student-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line)}

    .student-field{min-height:78px;padding:13px 15px;background:#fff}.student-field span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px}.student-field strong{display:block;line-height:1.55;word-break:break-word}

    .queue-title{background:#fff}.queue-title h3{color:#174e5d;font-size:21px}

    #bulkMarkBtn{background:#197a45;color:#fff}.toolbar button{min-height:46px}.primary{background:#2f7f96}.secondary{background:#e9f4f7;color:#246b80}.ghost{border-color:#9bc5d1;color:#246b80}

    @media(max-width:980px){.student-fields{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.brand-mark{width:100px;height:72px}}

    @media(max-width:650px){.student-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}.student-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.hero{padding:20px}.toolbar button{width:100%}}

     

    body{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif!important;background:#f6f4ee!important;color:#17313d!important}

    h1,h2,h3,.brand-title,.nav-title,.primary{font-family:"Noto Kufi Arabic","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.025em}

    .side{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#174c5b,#103a46)!important;box-shadow:-10px 0 35px rgba(13,49,59,.12)}

    .brand-mark{height:145px!important;padding:9px!important;border-radius:22px!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.13)!important}.brand-mark img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important}

    .main{background:linear-gradient(rgba(246,244,238,.96),rgba(246,244,238,.98)),repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 0 42px,rgba(201,168,102,.11) 43px 45px)!important}

    .hero{padding:27px!important;border:1px solid #e2ddd2!important;border-radius:24px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(32,62,71,.09)!important}.hero h1{font-size:32px!important;color:#175f73!important}

    .panel{border:1px solid #e2ddd2!important;border-radius:20px!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 10px 27px rgba(32,62,71,.07)!important}.stat{min-height:132px!important}.stat strong{font-family:"Noto Kufi Arabic"!important;color:#247c95!important}

    .toolbar{padding:16px!important;border:1px solid #e2ddd2!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:#fff!important}.toolbar button,.home-link{border-radius:12px!important}

    .student-item{transition:.22s!important}.student-item:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 16px 35px rgba(32,62,71,.12)!important}.queue-title{border-radius:20px!important}

    input,select{min-height:50px!important;border-radius:13px!important;border-color:#d8d8d2!important;background:#fcfcfa!important}

    @media(max-width:760px){.main{padding:12px!important}.hero{padding:19px!important}.hero h1{font-size:24px!important}}

  </style>

<body class="">

  <div class="shell">



    <aside class="side">

      <div class="brand">

        <div class="brand-mark"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="شعار جمعية تذكرة"></div>

        <strong>لوحة بيانات<br>اختبارات الطلاب</strong>

      </div>



      <div class="nav">

        <div class="nav-title">الخدمات</div>

        <a href="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzpDJKLle8sT7AyxX_EhFNbRkYm2aE4Ztd3dToGb_qaZZwX4YtNMEBc5xBAR5M7aq4r/exec" target="_top">⌂ الرئيسية</a>

        <a href="?page=result">⌕ استعلام النتيجة</a>

        <a class="active" href="?page=dataentry">▣ مدخل البيانات</a>

      </div>



      <button id="logoutBtn" class="logout" hidden>

        ⇥ تسجيل الخروج

      </button>

    </aside>



    <main class="main">



      <header class="hero">

        <div>

          <small>نظام اختبارات المرحليات</small>

          <h1>مدخل البيانات</h1>

          <p>

            طابور الطلاب المكتملة اختباراتهم لنقل بياناتهم إلى النظام الخاص بمدخل البيانات

          </p>

        </div>



        <a class="home-link" href="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzpDJKLle8sT7AyxX_EhFNbRkYm2aE4Ztd3dToGb_qaZZwX4YtNMEBc5xBAR5M7aq4r/exec" target="_top">

          العودة للرئيسية

        </a>

      </header>



      <section id="loginView" class="panel login-card">

        <h2>تسجيل دخول مدخل البيانات</h2>



        <p>

          هذه الصفحة مخصصة للاستعراض والنقل فقط.

          لا تسمح بتعديل بيانات الطالب أو درجاته.

        </p>



        <form id="loginForm">



          <label for="password">الرقم السري</label>



          <input

            id="password"

            type="password"

            autocomplete="current-password"

            required

            placeholder="أدخل الرقم السري"

          >



          <button id="loginBtn" class="primary" type="submit">

            تسجيل الدخول

          </button>



          <div id="loginMessage" class="message" role="alert"></div>



        </form>

      </section>



      <section id="dashboard" class="dashboard">



        <section id="attachmentLoading" class="panel attachment-loading" hidden>

          <div>

            <strong id="attachmentLoadingTitle">جارٍ فتح المرفق…</strong>

            <span id="attachmentLoadingText">يرجى الانتظار لحظات حتى يكتمل التحميل.</span>

          </div>

        </section>



        <div class="stats">



          <div class="panel stat">

            <span>إجمالي المختبرين</span>

            <strong id="totalCount">0</strong>

          </div>



          <div class="panel stat done">

            <span>تم إدخالهم</span>

            <strong id="doneCount">0</strong>

          </div>



          <div class="panel stat left">

            <span>المتبقي للإدخال</span>

            <strong id="remainingCount">0</strong>

          </div>



        </div>



        <div class="panel progress-wrap">



          <div class="progress-head">

            <strong id="progressText">

              تم إدخال 0 من 0 — المتبقي 0

            </strong>



            <span id="progressPercent">0%</span>

          </div>



          <div class="progress-track">

            <div id="progressBar" class="progress-bar"></div>

          </div>



        </div>



        <div class="attachment-feature-note">

          يدعم ملف Excel مرفقات طلاب المرحلة الأولى، ويظهر عمود المرفق مباشرة بجوار «المرحلية».

        </div>



        <div class="toolbar">



          <button id="refreshBtn" class="secondary">

            ↻ تحديث القائمة

          </button>



          <button id="exportAllBtn" class="ghost">

            ⇩ تنزيل Excel مع مرفقات المرحلة الأولى

          </button>



          <button id="bulkMarkBtn" class="success">

            ✓ تم رفع جميع الطلاب الظاهرين على النظام

          </button>



        </div>



        <div id="pageMessage" class="message" role="alert"></div>



        <section id="attachmentViewer" class="panel attachment-viewer" hidden>

          <div class="attachment-viewer-head">

            <div>

              <strong id="attachmentTitle">مرفق المرحلة الأولى</strong>

              <span id="attachmentStudent"></span>

            </div>

            <button id="closeAttachmentBtn" class="ghost" type="button">إغلاق</button>

          </div>

          <div id="attachmentPreview" class="attachment-preview"></div>

          <div class="attachment-actions">

            <a id="downloadAttachmentBtn" class="attachment-download" href="#" download>تنزيل المرفق</a>

          </div>

        </section>



        <section id="currentStudent"></section>



        <section id="queueTable"></section>



        <p class="privacy">

          تظهر الهوية والجوال كاملين داخل جلسة مدخل البيانات المصرح بها فقط.

          التصدير أو النسخ لا يغير حالة الطالب.

          تتغير حالة الرفع على النظام فقط عند الضغط على زر «تم رفعه على النظام».

          حالة تسجيل الطالب على رافد معلومة مستقلة ولا تتغير من هذه الصفحة.

        </p>



      </section>



    </main>

  </div>



  <script>

    (function(){

      'use strict';



      var WEB_APP_URL = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzpDJKLle8sT7AyxX_EhFNbRkYm2aE4Ztd3dToGb_qaZZwX4YtNMEBc5xBAR5M7aq4r/exec";

      var REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID = "";

      var REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_TICKET = "";

      var UNIFIED_STAFF_TOKEN = '';

      try{ UNIFIED_STAFF_TOKEN = sessionStorage.getItem('TDK_DATA_ENTRY_AUTH') || ''; }catch(ignore){}



      var token = '';

      var students = [];

      var progress = {

        total:0,

        completed:0,

        remaining:0

      };



      var busy = false;



      var loginView = document.getElementById('loginView');

      var dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboard');

      var loginForm = document.getElementById('loginForm');

      var passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');

      var loginBtn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');

      var logoutBtn = document.getElementById('logoutBtn');

      var refreshBtn = document.getElementById('refreshBtn');

      var bulkMarkBtn = document.getElementById('bulkMarkBtn');

      var exportAllBtn = document.getElementById('exportAllBtn');

      var attachmentViewer = document.getElementById('attachmentViewer');

      var attachmentPreview = document.getElementById('attachmentPreview');

      var attachmentStudent = document.getElementById('attachmentStudent');

      var downloadAttachmentBtn = document.getElementById('downloadAttachmentBtn');

      var closeAttachmentBtn = document.getElementById('closeAttachmentBtn');

      var attachmentObjectUrl = '';

      var attachmentLoading = document.getElementById('attachmentLoading');

      var attachmentLoadingTitle = document.getElementById('attachmentLoadingTitle');

      var attachmentLoadingText = document.getElementById('attachmentLoadingText');





      function request(payload,onSuccess,onFailure){



        google.script.run



          .withSuccessHandler(function(response){



            var result = normalizeResponse(response);



            if(result && result.code === 'INVALID_SESSION'){

              resetSession(result.message);

              return;

            }



            onSuccess(result || {});

          })



          .withFailureHandler(function(error){



            var message =

              error && error.message

                ? error.message

                : 'تعذر الاتصال بالنظام.';



            if(onFailure){

              onFailure(message);

            }

          })



          .dataEntryRequest(payload);

      }





      function normalizeResponse(value){



        if(typeof value === 'string'){



          try{

            return JSON.parse(value);



          }catch(ignore){



            return {

              ok:false,

              message:value

            };

          }

        }



        return value || {};

      }





      function setBusy(button,state,label){



        if(!button){

          return;

        }



        if(state){



          button.dataset.oldText = button.textContent;

          button.textContent = label || 'جارٍ التنفيذ';

          button.classList.add('loading');

          button.disabled = true;



        }else{



          button.textContent =

            button.dataset.oldText ||

            button.textContent;



          button.classList.remove('loading');

          button.disabled = false;

        }

      }





      function showMessage(element,message,type){



        element.textContent = message || '';



        element.className =

          'message' +

          (

            message

              ? ' ' + (type || 'error')

              : ''

          );

      }





      loginForm.addEventListener('submit',function(event){



        event.preventDefault();



        if(busy){

          return;

        }



        var password = passwordInput.value.trim();



        if(!password){



          showMessage(

            document.getElementById('loginMessage'),

            'أدخل الرقم السري.',

            'error'

          );



          return;

        }



        busy = true;



        setBusy(

          loginBtn,

          true,

          'جارٍ تسجيل الدخول'

        );



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('loginMessage'),

          '',

          ''

        );



        request(

          {

            action:'dataentrylogin',

            password:password,

            source:'صفحة مدخل البيانات'

          },



          function(result){



            busy = false;

            setBusy(loginBtn,false);

            passwordInput.value = '';



            if(!result.ok){



              showMessage(

                document.getElementById('loginMessage'),

                result.message || 'تعذر تسجيل الدخول.',

                'error'

              );



              return;

            }



            token =

              result.token ||

              result.sessionToken ||

              '';



            loginView.style.display = 'none';

            dashboard.style.display = 'block';

            logoutBtn.hidden = false;



            if(REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID){

              loadRequestedAttachment();

            }else{

              loadQueue();

            }

          },



          function(message){



            busy = false;

            setBusy(loginBtn,false);



            showMessage(

              document.getElementById('loginMessage'),

              message,

              'error'

            );

          }

        );

      });





      function loadQueue(){



        if(!token){

          return;

        }



        setBusy(

          refreshBtn,

          true,

          'جارٍ التحديث'

        );



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

          '',

          ''

        );



        request(

          {

            action:'dataentryqueue',

            token:token,

            source:'صفحة مدخل البيانات'

          },



          function(result){



            setBusy(refreshBtn,false);



            if(!result.ok){



              showMessage(

                document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

                result.message || 'تعذر تحميل قائمة الطلاب.',

                'error'

              );



              return;

            }



            students =

              Array.isArray(result.students)

                ? result.students

                : [];



            progress =

              result.progress ||

              {

                total:students.length,

                completed:0,

                remaining:students.length

              };



            render();

          },



          function(message){



            setBusy(refreshBtn,false);



            showMessage(

              document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

              message,

              'error'

            );

          }

        );

      }





      function render(){



        document.getElementById('totalCount').textContent =

          number(progress.total);



        document.getElementById('doneCount').textContent =

          number(progress.completed);



        document.getElementById('remainingCount').textContent =

          number(progress.remaining);



        document.getElementById('progressText').textContent =

          'تم إدخال ' +

          number(progress.completed) +

          ' من ' +

          number(progress.total) +

          ' — المتبقي ' +

          number(progress.remaining);



        var percent =

          progress.total

            ? Math.round(

                (progress.completed / progress.total) * 100

              )

            : 0;



        document.getElementById('progressPercent').textContent =

          number(percent) + '%';



        document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width =

          percent + '%';



        bulkMarkBtn.disabled = !students.length;

        exportAllBtn.disabled = !students.length;



        renderCurrent();

        renderQueue();

      }





      function loadRequestedAttachment(){



        if(!token || !REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID){

          return;

        }



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

          'جارٍ فتح مرفق المرحلة الأولى...',

          'ok'

        );



        request(

          {

            action:'dataentryattachment',

            token:token,

            requestId:REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID,

            source:'رابط مرفق المرحلة الأولى في ملف Excel'

          },

          function(result){

            if(!result.ok){

              showMessage(

                document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

                result.message || 'تعذر فتح المرفق.',

                'error'

              );

              return;

            }



            showAttachment(result);

            showMessage(document.getElementById('pageMessage'),'','');

            loadQueue();

          },

          function(message){

            showMessage(

              document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

              message || 'تعذر فتح المرفق.',

              'error'

            );

          }

        );

      }





      function loadRequestedAttachmentByTicket(){

        if(!REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID || !REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_TICKET){

          return;

        }



        request(

          {

            action:'dataentryattachmentticket',

            requestId:REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID,

            ticket:REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_TICKET,

            source:'تذكرة مرفق المرحلة الأولى من ملف Excel'

          },

          function(result){

            if(!result.ok){

              showAttachmentModeError(

                result.message || 'تعذر فتح المرفق. ارجع إلى مدخل البيانات ونزّل ملف Excel جديدًا.'

              );

              return;

            }



            attachmentLoading.hidden = true;

            showAttachment(result);

          },

          function(message){

            showAttachmentModeError(

              message || 'تعذر فتح المرفق. ارجع إلى مدخل البيانات ونزّل ملف Excel جديدًا.'

            );

          }

        );

      }





      function showAttachmentModeError(message){

        attachmentLoading.hidden = false;

        attachmentLoadingTitle.textContent = 'تعذر فتح المرفق';

        attachmentLoadingText.textContent = message || 'تعذر فتح المرفق.';

      }





      function showAttachment(result){

        clearAttachmentPreview();



        var binary = atob(String(result.content || ''));

        var bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);

        for(var i = 0; i < binary.length; i++){

          bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);

        }



        var blob = new Blob([bytes],{type:String(result.mimeType || 'application/octet-stream')});

        attachmentObjectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        attachmentStudent.textContent = result.studentName ? 'الطالب: ' + result.studentName : '';

        downloadAttachmentBtn.href = attachmentObjectUrl;

        downloadAttachmentBtn.download = safeFileName(result.fileName || 'مرفق_المرحلة_الأولى');



        if(String(result.mimeType || '').indexOf('image/') === 0){

          var image = document.createElement('img');

          image.src = attachmentObjectUrl;

          image.alt = result.fileName || 'مرفق المرحلة الأولى';

          attachmentPreview.appendChild(image);

        }else if(String(result.mimeType || '').toLowerCase() === 'application/pdf'){

          renderPdfAttachment(bytes,result.fileName || 'مرفق المرحلة الأولى');

        }else{

          var frame = document.createElement('iframe');

          frame.src = attachmentObjectUrl;

          frame.title = result.fileName || 'مرفق المرحلة الأولى';

          attachmentPreview.appendChild(frame);

        }



        attachmentViewer.hidden = false;

        attachmentViewer.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});

      }





      function renderPdfAttachment(bytes,fileName){

        attachmentPreview.classList.add('pdf-pages');

        if(!window.pdfjsLib){

          attachmentPreview.innerHTML = '<div class="attachment-loading"><div><strong>تعذر تشغيل معاينة PDF</strong><span>يمكن تنزيل المرفق من الزر أدناه.</span></div></div>';

          return;

        }

        window.pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js';

        window.pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:bytes}).promise.then(function(pdf){

          var chain = Promise.resolve();

          for(var pageNumber = 1; pageNumber <= pdf.numPages; pageNumber++){

            (function(number){

              chain = chain.then(function(){

                return pdf.getPage(number).then(function(page){

                  var viewport = page.getViewport({scale:1.45});

                  var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

                  canvas.setAttribute('aria-label',fileName + ' — الصفحة ' + number);

                  canvas.width = viewport.width;

                  canvas.height = viewport.height;

                  attachmentPreview.appendChild(canvas);

                  return page.render({canvasContext:canvas.getContext('2d'),viewport:viewport}).promise;

                });

              });

            })(pageNumber);

          }

          return chain;

        }).catch(function(){

          attachmentPreview.classList.remove('pdf-pages');

          attachmentPreview.innerHTML = '<div class="attachment-loading"><div><strong>تعذر عرض المرفق داخل الصفحة</strong><span>يمكن تنزيل المرفق من الزر أدناه.</span></div></div>';

        });

      }





      function clearAttachmentPreview(){

        attachmentPreview.innerHTML = '';

        attachmentPreview.classList.remove('pdf-pages');

        attachmentViewer.hidden = true;

        downloadAttachmentBtn.removeAttribute('href');

        if(attachmentObjectUrl){

          URL.revokeObjectURL(attachmentObjectUrl);

          attachmentObjectUrl = '';

        }

      }





      function renderCurrent(){

        var host = document.getElementById('currentStudent');

        if(students.length){ host.innerHTML = ''; return; }

        host.innerHTML = '<div class="panel empty"><div class="icon">✓</div><h2>اكتمل طابور الإدخال</h2><p>لا يوجد طلاب مكتملة اختباراتهم بانتظار الرفع على النظام.</p></div>';

      }



      function renderQueue(){

        var host = document.getElementById('queueTable');

        if(!students.length){ host.innerHTML = ''; return; }

        host.innerHTML = '<div class="queue-title panel"><h3>قائمة الطلاب بانتظار الرفع</h3><span>'+number(students.length)+' طالب</span></div><div class="student-list">'+students.map(function(s,index){

          var fields=[

            ['اسم الطالب الرباعي',s.studentName],['رقم الهوية أو الإقامة',s.idNumber],['الجنسية',s.nationality],['رقم الجوال',localMobile(s.guardianPhone)],

            ['المركز الإشرافي',s.examVenue],['اسم الحلقة (الجامع)',s.groupName],['المرحلية',s.level],['الدرجة',s.degree],

            ['التقدير',s.grade],['تاريخ الاختبار',s.examDate],['معلم الحلقة',s.teacherName],['المشرف التعليمي',s.educationalSupervisor],

            ['تم تسجيل بيانات الطلب على رافد من خلال المعلم',s.rafidStatus]

          ];

          return '<article class="panel student-item"><div class="student-head"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px"><span class="student-number">'+number(index+1)+'</span><h3>'+escapeHtml(value(s.studentName))+'</h3></div><span class="student-status">'+escapeHtml(value(s.uploadedStatus))+'</span></div><div class="student-fields">'+fields.map(function(field){return '<div class="student-field"><span>'+escapeHtml(field[0])+'</span><strong>'+escapeHtml(value(field[1]))+'</strong></div>';}).join('')+'</div></article>';

        }).join('')+'</div>';

      }



      function markAllDone(){

        if(busy || !students.length){ return; }

        var queue = students.slice();

        if(!window.confirm('هل انتهيت من رفع بيانات جميع الطلاب الظاهرين وعددهم '+queue.length+'؟\n\nسيتم اعتمادهم جميعاً بضغطة واحدة.')){ return; }

        busy = true; var index = 0;

        setBusy(bulkMarkBtn,true,'جارٍ اعتماد 0 من '+queue.length);

        showMessage(document.getElementById('pageMessage'),'','');

        function next(){

          if(index >= queue.length){

            busy=false; setBusy(bulkMarkBtn,false);

            showMessage(document.getElementById('pageMessage'),'تم تأكيد رفع جميع الطلاب الظاهرين على النظام بنجاح.','ok');

            loadQueue(); return;

          }

          var current=queue[index]; bulkMarkBtn.textContent='جارٍ اعتماد '+(index+1)+' من '+queue.length;

          request({action:'dataentrymarkuploaded',token:token,requestId:current.requestId,source:'اعتماد جماعي من صفحة مدخل البيانات'},function(result){

            if(!result.ok){busy=false;setBusy(bulkMarkBtn,false);showMessage(document.getElementById('pageMessage'),result.message||'تعذر اعتماد أحد الطلاب.','error');loadQueue();return;}

            index++; next();

          },function(message){busy=false;setBusy(bulkMarkBtn,false);showMessage(document.getElementById('pageMessage'),message,'error');loadQueue();});

        }

        next();

      }



      function markCurrentDone(){



        if(busy || !students.length){

          return;

        }



        var current = students[0];



        var confirmed =

          window.confirm(

            'هل انتهيت من إدخال بيانات الطالب «' +

            current.studentName +

            '» في النظام الخاص بك؟\n\n' +

            'بعد التأكيد ستصبح حالته «مرفوعة على النظام» وسيظهر الطالب التالي.'

          );



        if(!confirmed){

          return;

        }



        var button =

          document.getElementById('markDoneBtn');



        busy = true;



        setBusy(

          button,

          true,

          'جارٍ تأكيد الرفع'

        );



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

          '',

          ''

        );



        request(

          {

            action:'dataentrymarkuploaded',

            token:token,

            requestId:current.requestId,

            source:'صفحة مدخل البيانات'

          },



          function(result){



            busy = false;

            setBusy(button,false);



            if(!result.ok){



              showMessage(

                document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

                result.message || 'تعذر تحديث حالة الطالب.',

                'error'

              );



              return;

            }



            students =

              Array.isArray(result.students)

                ? result.students

                : [];



            progress =

              result.progress ||

              progress;



            showMessage(

              document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

              result.message || 'تم تحديث حالة الطالب.',

              'ok'

            );



            render();



            window.scrollTo({

              top:0,

              behavior:'smooth'

            });

          },



          function(message){



            busy = false;

            setBusy(button,false);



            showMessage(

              document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

              message,

              'error'

            );

          }

        );

      }





      function copyCurrent(){



        if(!students.length){

          return;

        }



        var s = students[0];



        var text = [



          'اسم الطالب الرباعي: ' +

          value(s.studentName),



          'رقم الهوية أو الإقامة: ' +

          value(s.idNumber),



          'الجنسية: ' +

          value(s.nationality),



          'رقم الجوال المسجل: ' +

          value(localMobile(s.guardianPhone)),



          'اسم الحلقة أو الجامع: ' +

          value(s.groupName),



          'اسم المشرف التعليمي: ' +

          value(s.educationalSupervisor),



          'المرحلية: ' +

          value(s.level),



          'الدرجة: ' +

          value(s.degree),



          'التقدير: ' +

          value(s.grade),



          'تاريخ الاختبار: ' +

          value(s.examDate),



          'تم تسجيل الطالب على رافد: ' +

          value(s.rafidStatus),



          'حالة الرفع على النظام: ' +

          value(s.uploadedStatus)



        ].join('\n');



        if(

          navigator.clipboard &&

          navigator.clipboard.writeText

        ){



          navigator.clipboard

            .writeText(text)

            .then(function(){



              showMessage(

                document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

                'تم نسخ بيانات الطالب.',

                'ok'

              );



            })

            .catch(function(){



              fallbackCopy(text);

            });



        }else{



          fallbackCopy(text);

        }

      }





      function fallbackCopy(text){



        var area =

          document.createElement('textarea');



        area.value = text;

        area.style.position = 'fixed';

        area.style.opacity = '0';



        document.body.appendChild(area);



        area.select();



        document.execCommand('copy');



        document.body.removeChild(area);



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

          'تم نسخ بيانات الطالب.',

          'ok'

        );

      }





      function exportExcel(rows,fileName){



        if(!rows || !rows.length){

          return;

        }



        var headers = [



          'اسم الطالب الرباعي',

          'رقم الهوية أو الإقامة',

          'الجنسية',

          'رقم الجوال المسجل',

          'المركز الإشرافي',

          'اسم الحلقة (الجامع)',

          'المرحلية',

          'مرفق المرحلة الأولى',

          'الدرجة',

          'التقدير',

          'تاريخ الاختبار',

          'معلم الحلقة',

          'المشرف التعليمي',

          'تم تسجيل بيانات الطلب على رافد من خلال المعلم',

          'حالة الرفع على النظام'

        ];



        var body =

          rows.map(function(s){



            var cells = [



              s.studentName,

              s.idNumber,

              s.nationality,

              localMobile(s.guardianPhone),

              s.examVenue,

              s.groupName,

              s.level,

              s.hasFirstStageAttachment && s.attachmentTicket

                ? attachmentPageUrl(s.requestId,s.attachmentTicket)

                : '',

              s.degree,

              s.grade,

              s.examDate,

              s.teacherName,

              s.educationalSupervisor,

              s.rafidStatus,

              s.uploadedStatus

            ];



            return (

              '<tr>' +



              cells.map(function(cell,index){



                var textStyle =

                  index === 1 ||

                  index === 3

                    ? ' style="mso-number-format:\\@;"'

                    : '';



                if(index === 7 && cell){

                  return (

                    '<td>' +

                      '<a href="' + escapeHtml(String(cell)) + '" target="_blank">فتح المرفق</a>' +

                    '</td>'

                  );

                }



                return (

                  '<td' +

                  textStyle +

                  '>' +

                  escapeHtml(value(cell)) +

                  '</td>'

                );



              }).join('') +



              '</tr>'

            );



          }).join('');



        var html =



          '<html dir="rtl">' +



          '<head>' +

            '<meta charset="utf-8">' +

          '</head>' +



          '<body>' +



            '<table border="1">' +



              '<thead>' +

                '<tr>' +



                  headers.map(function(h){



                    return (

                      '<th style="background:#174e5d;color:#fff">' +

                        escapeHtml(h) +

                      '</th>'

                    );



                  }).join('') +



                '</tr>' +

              '</thead>' +



              '<tbody>' +

                body +

              '</tbody>' +



            '</table>' +



          '</body>' +



          '</html>';



        var blob =

          new Blob(

            ['\ufeff',html],

            {

              type:'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8'

            }

          );



        var url =

          URL.createObjectURL(blob);



        var link =

          document.createElement('a');



        link.href = url;



        link.download =

          safeFileName(

            fileName ||

            'بيانات_المختبرين'

          ) +

          '.xls';



        document.body.appendChild(link);



        link.click();



        document.body.removeChild(link);



        setTimeout(function(){

          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

        },1000);



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('pageMessage'),

          'تم تجهيز ملف Excel. لم تتغير حالة أي طالب.',

          'ok'

        );

      }





      function resetSession(message){



        token = '';

        try{ sessionStorage.removeItem('TDK_DATA_ENTRY_AUTH'); }catch(ignore){}

        try{ sessionStorage.removeItem('studentExamAuthToken'); }catch(ignore){}

        try{ sessionStorage.removeItem('studentExamAuthSession'); }catch(ignore){}

        try{ localStorage.removeItem('studentExamAuthToken'); }catch(ignore){}

        try{ localStorage.removeItem('studentExamAuthSession'); }catch(ignore){}

        students = [];

        clearAttachmentPreview();



        progress = {

          total:0,

          completed:0,

          remaining:0

        };



        dashboard.style.display = 'none';

        loginView.style.display = 'block';

        logoutBtn.hidden = true;



        showMessage(

          document.getElementById('loginMessage'),

          message || 'انتهت الجلسة.',

          'error'

        );



        setTimeout(function(){

          window.top.location.replace(WEB_APP_URL + '?page=admin&logout=1');

        },250);

      }





      logoutBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){



        var oldToken = token;



        resetSession('');



        if(oldToken){



          request(

            {

              action:'dataentrylogout',

              token:oldToken

            },

            function(){},

            function(){}

          );

        }

      });





      refreshBtn.addEventListener(

        'click',

        loadQueue

      );





      bulkMarkBtn.addEventListener('click',markAllDone);



      closeAttachmentBtn.addEventListener('click',clearAttachmentPreview);



      exportAllBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){



        exportExcel(

          students,

          'المختبرون_بانتظار_الرفع_مع_مرفقات_المرحلة_الأولى'

        );

      });





      function escapeHtml(valueToEscape){



        return String(

          valueToEscape == null

            ? ''

            : valueToEscape

        )

          .replace(/&/g,'&')

          .replace(/</g,'<')

          .replace(/>/g,'>')

          .replace(/"/g,'"')

          .replace(/'/g,''');

      }





      function safeFileName(name){



        return String(name || 'بيانات')

          .replace(/[\/:*?"<>|]+/g,'_')

          .trim() ||

          'بيانات';

      }





      function attachmentPageUrl(requestId,attachmentTicket){

        var base = String(WEB_APP_URL || '').trim();

        if(!base){

          base = window.location.href.split('?')[0];

        }

        return base +

          '?page=dataentry&attachment=' + encodeURIComponent(String(requestId || '')) +

          '&ticket=' + encodeURIComponent(String(attachmentTicket || ''));

      }





      function value(v){



        return (

          v === null ||

          v === undefined ||

          String(v).trim() === ''

        )

          ? '—'

          : String(v);

      }





      function localMobile(phone){



        var raw =

          String(phone == null ? '' : phone).trim();



        if(!raw){

          return '';

        }



        var digits = raw

          .replace(/[٠-٩]/g,function(digit){

            return String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(digit));

          })

          .replace(/\D/g,'');



        if(/^5\d{8}$/.test(digits)){

          return '0' + digits;

        }



        if(/^9665\d{8}$/.test(digits)){

          return '0' + digits.slice(3);

        }



        if(/^05\d{8}$/.test(digits)){

          return digits;

        }



        return raw;

      }





      function number(n){



        return new Intl.NumberFormat(

          'ar-SA'

        ).format(

          Number(n || 0)

        );

      }





      if(REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_ID && REQUESTED_ATTACHMENT_TICKET){

        document.body.classList.add('attachment-mode');

        loginView.style.display = 'none';

        dashboard.style.display = 'block';

        logoutBtn.hidden = true;

        attachmentLoading.hidden = false;

        loadRequestedAttachmentByTicket();

      }else if(UNIFIED_STAFF_TOKEN){

        token = UNIFIED_STAFF_TOKEN;

        loginView.style.display = 'none';

        dashboard.style.display = 'block';

        logoutBtn.hidden = false;

        loadQueue();

      }else{

        window.top.location.href = WEB_APP_URL + '?page=admin';

      }



    })();

  </script>
